overview: PayFlow is a comprehensive, production-grade digital wallet and peer-to-peer payments platform. It delivers a full fintech experience — send and receive money, manage multi-currency wallets, track spending with analytics, save toward goals, manage cards with advanced controls, view an activity feed with reactions, and much more. Designed to rival PayPal, CashApp, and Revolut.
features: Multi-currency wallet (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY) with live FX rates
P2P transfers via username, phone, QR code, or user ID
Spending analytics with charts, category breakdowns, and budget tools
Savings goals and vaults with round-up automation
Advanced card management: freeze/unfreeze, virtual card, spend controls
Activity feed with emoji reactions on payments
Notifications center with read/unread state
Loyalty points, cashback, and referral rewards
Subscription tiers (Free to Enterprise) with Stripe billing
Gamification: streaks, badges, achievements, leaderboard
Recurring and scheduled transfers
Split bills and group expenses
P2P payment links and bulk payments
Bill payments: utilities, phone top-up
Money pools for crowdfunding between friends
Dispute and chargeback flow
Help center with FAQ and chat support
Crypto wallet UI with live price ticker
Business analytics dashboard
Tax form generation and bank statement PDF download
